messages.subject: Issues with predicting the dependent variables from estimates
parts:
Hi all,

I am working on fitting a negative binomial model to count data using rstan.

The main challenge I am facing currently is on predicting the boundary values (2.5%. 50%, and 97.5%) of the dependent variable using the estimated coefficients (beta values) and the observed data.

When I implemented that using the rbinom function and quantile function, I got skewed results i.e. the lower bound results were very small and far from the median value, while the upper bound results were very large and very far from the median value as well.

I checked the kernel density of of my results, and this is what i found on Log-posterior (refer to attached plot); that is the plot was skewed much to the right and with a long tail on the left.

What I am not sure is does this distribution have relation with the skewed prediction results I am getting.

I will appreciate anyone help.

Thanks.

### specifying the poisson-gamma model for comparison_before crashes
negbin<-"
data{
int<lower=0> N;                           # rows of data
vector[N] studyperiod;
vector[N] majaadt;              # predictor variable
vector[N] minaadt;              # predictor variable
vector[N] majlane;              # predictor variable
vector[N] minlane;              # predictor variable
vector[N] medianwidth;          # predictor variable
vector[N] speed;                # predictor variable
vector[N] landuse;              # predictor variable
vector[N] mediantype;           # predictor variable
int<lower=0> totalcrashes[N];   # response variable
}

parameters {
real<lower=0> phi;      # negative binomial dispersion parameter
real beta0;             # intercept
real beta3;
real beta5;
real beta6;
real beta7;
real beta8;
real beta9;
real beta10;
real beta11;
real beta12;
}

model {
### priors
phi    ~    gamma(0.00001,0.00001);
beta0  ~    normal(0.0,5);
beta3  ~    normal(0.0, 100);
beta5  ~    normal(0.0, 100);
beta6  ~    normal(0.0, 100);
beta7  ~    normal(0.0, 100);
beta8  ~    normal(0.0, 100);
beta9  ~    normal(0.0, 100);
beta10 ~    normal(0.0, 100);
beta11 ~    normal(0.0, 100);
beta12 ~    normal(0.0, 100);

# model formula
totalcrashes ~ neg_binomial_2_log(beta0 + beta3*studyperiod + beta5*majaadt + beta6*minaadt + beta7*majlane + beta8*minlane + beta9*speed + beta10*landuse + beta11*medianwidth + beta12*mediantype, phi);
}
"
write(negbin, file="neg_binomial_2-CB.stan")
CB<-stan_model("neg_binomial_2-CB.stan")
set.seed(1000)
N       <-  276
phi     <-  0.524658  
beta0   <- -3.279956
beta3   <- -0.0709271 
beta5   <-  0.0807461
beta6   <-  0.3647194
beta7   <-  0.0069352
beta8   <-  0.0548912
beta9   <-  0.7149454
beta10  <-  0.3034317 
beta11  <-  0.0014502 
beta12  <- -0.1764844
comparisonbefore<-sampling(CB, data=list(N=N, totalcrashes=crashdata_CB$totalcrashes, studyperiod=crashdata_CB$studyperiod, majaadt=crashdata_CB$majaadt, minaadt=crashdata_CB$minaadt, majlane=crashdata_CB$majlane, minlane=crashdata_CB$minlane, speed=crashdata_CB$speed, landuse=crashdata_CB$landuse, medianwidth=crashdata_CB$medianwidth, mediantype=crashdata_CB$mediantype), 
                          pars=c("beta0", "beta3", "beta5", "beta6", "beta7", "beta8", "beta9", "beta10", "beta11", "beta12", 'phi'),
                          iter=5000, warmup=2000, chains=2)
comparisonbefore

### launching shinystan
library(shinystan)
launch_shinystan(comparisonbefore)

# plot the output
rstan::traceplot(comparisonbefore, inc_warmup=FALSE)
plot(comparisonbefore)

### predicting comparison before crashes
ph<-as.data.frame(rstan::extract(comparisonbefore, pars='phi'))
b0<-as.data.frame(rstan::extract(comparisonbefore, pars='beta0'))
b3<-as.data.frame(rstan::extract(comparisonbefore, pars='beta3'))
b5<-as.data.frame(rstan::extract(comparisonbefore, pars='beta5'))
b6<-as.data.frame(rstan::extract(comparisonbefore, pars='beta6'))
b7<-as.data.frame(rstan::extract(comparisonbefore, pars='beta7'))
b8<-as.data.frame(rstan::extract(comparisonbefore, pars='beta8'))
b9<-as.data.frame(rstan::extract(comparisonbefore, pars='beta9'))
b10<-as.data.frame(rstan::extract(comparisonbefore, pars='beta10'))
b11<-as.data.frame(rstan::extract(comparisonbefore, pars='beta11'))
b12<-as.data.frame(rstan::extract(comparisonbefore, pars='beta12'))

# lower quartile (2.5%)
phlowerQ<-quantile(ph$phi,      probs = 0.025)
blowerQ0<-quantile(b0$beta0,    probs = 0.025)
blowerQ3<-quantile(b3$beta3,    probs = 0.025)
blowerQ5<-quantile(b5$beta5,    probs = 0.025)
blowerQ6<-quantile(b6$beta6,    probs = 0.025)
blowerQ7<-quantile(b7$beta7,    probs = 0.025)
blowerQ8<-quantile(b8$beta8,    probs = 0.025)
blowerQ9<-quantile(b9$beta9,    probs = 0.025)
blowerQ10<-quantile(b10$beta10, probs = 0.025)
blowerQ11<-quantile(b11$beta11, probs = 0.025)
blowerQ12<-quantile(b12$beta12, probs = 0.025)

CB_lowerQ_pred<-rnbinom(276, 
                 size = phlowerQ, 
                 mu=exp(blowerQ0 + blowerQ3*crashdata_CB$studyperiod + blowerQ5*crashdata_CB$majaadt + blowerQ6*crashdata_CB$minaadt +blowerQ7*crashdata_CB$majlane + blowerQ8*crashdata_CB$minlane + blowerQ9*crashdata_CB$speed + blowerQ10*crashdata_CB$landuse + blowerQ11*crashdata_CB$medianwidth + blowerQ12*crashdata_CB$mediantype))
CB_lowerQ_pred
plot(CB_lowerQ_pred)
summary('CB_lowerQ_pred')
CB_lowerQ_1<-CB_lowerQ_pred[1:92]
CB_lowerQ_2<-CB_lowerQ_pred[93:184]
CB_lowerQ_3<-CB_lowerQ_pred[185:276]
CB_lowerQ_site<-(CB_lowerQ_1+CB_lowerQ_2+CB_lowerQ_3)/3
CB_lowerQ_site

# plot predicted & observed crashes
plot(CB_lowerQ_site,  type="h")
plot((crashdata_CB$totalcrashes[1:92]+crashdata_CB$totalcrashes[93:184]+crashdata_CB$totalcrashes[185:276])/3, type="h")


# middle quartile (50%)
phmean<-quantile(ph$phi,      probs = 0.5)
bmean0<-quantile(b0$beta0,    probs = 0.5)
bmean3<-quantile(b3$beta3,    probs = 0.5)

bmean10<-quantile(b10$beta10, probs = 0.5)
bmean11<-quantile(b11$beta11, probs = 0.5)
bmean12<-quantile(b12$beta12, probs = 0.5)

CB_mean_pred<-rnbinom(276, 
                      size = phmean, 
                      mu=exp(bmean0 + bmean3*crashdata_CB$studyperiod + bmean5*crashdata_CB$majaadt + bmean6*crashdata_CB$minaadt +bmean7*crashdata_CB$majlane + bmean8*crashdata_CB$minlane + bmean9*crashdata_CB$speed + bmean10*crashdata_CB$landuse + bmean11*crashdata_CB$medianwidth + bmean12*crashdata_CB$mediantype))
CB_mean_pred

summary('CB_mean_pred')
CB_mean_1<-CB_mean_pred[1:92]
CB_mean_2<-CB_mean_pred[93:184]
CB_mean_3<-CB_mean_pred[185:276]
CB_mean_site<-(CB_mean_1+CB_mean_2+CB_mean_3)/3
CB_mean_site

plot((crashdata_CB$totalcrashes[1:92]+crashdata_CB$totalcrashes[93:184]+crashdata_CB$totalcrashes[185:276])/3, type="h")


# Upper quartile (97.5%)
phupperQ<-quantile(ph$phi,      probs = 0.975)
bupperQ0<-quantile(b0$beta0,    probs = 0.975)
bupperQ3<-quantile(b3$beta3,    probs = 0.975)

CB_upperQ_pred<-rnbinom(276, 
                      size = phupperQ, 
                      mu=exp(bupperQ0 + bupperQ3*crashdata_CB$studyperiod + bupperQ5*crashdata_CB$majaadt + bupperQ6*crashdata_CB$minaadt +bupperQ7*crashdata_CB$majlane + bupperQ8*crashdata_CB$minlane + bupperQ9*crashdata_CB$speed + bupperQ10*crashdata_CB$landuse + bupperQ11*crashdata_CB$medianwidth + bupperQ12*crashdata_CB$mediantype))

I'm guessing part of your problem is the fat priors. We don't
like those gamma(epsilon, epsilon) priors for exactly the reason
you bring up. Andrew's written papers about it that we reference
from the recommended priors section of the manual.

- Bob
